original_annual_columns: year; anomaly (K); total error variance (K^2); high-frequency error variance (K^2); low-frequency error variance (K^2); bias error variance (K^2)
extracted_columns: year; anomaly_c (numerically identical to the source K anomaly because temperature differences have equal K and Celsius magnitudes)
excluded_data: 2026 annual value excluded because source snapshot is dated 202606 and 2026 was not a complete calendar year.
uncertainty_note: The four variance columns are shown as -999 for the selected source rows; they were treated as unavailable and not used as numeric uncertainty estimates.
extraction_note: The archived CSV is a narrow, two-column extraction of the annual global series for transparent reproduction; it is not the full NOAA source file.
